hooks.command:
cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$cmd" ] && exit 0; echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'jamf-cli [^|&;]* (create|update|apply|patch) ' || exit 0; echo "$cmd" | grep -q -- '--scaffold' && exit 0; printf '[jamf-cli] Spec check required before this mutation.
Load the API spec first (WebFetch), then run --scaffold to get the exact template.
  Platform — fetch from specs/platform/ (filenames are abbreviated, NOT <resource>-api.json):
    blueprints              -> blueprints-api.json
    compliance-benchmarks   -> jamf-compliance-benchmark-engine-api.json
    platform-devices        -> device-inventory-api.json (+ device-management-actions-api.json)
    platform-device-groups  -> device-groups-api.json
    ddm-reports             -> Declaration-reporting-openapi.json
    base: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jamf-Concepts/jamf-cli/main/specs/platform/
  Classic API (/JSSResource/ paths):
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jamf-Concepts/jamf-cli/main/specs/classic/resources.yaml
  Pro modern API (all other resources):
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jamf-Concepts/jamf-cli/main/specs/<ResourceName>.yaml
' >&2; exit 0
